step1_analysis.description: A current-mode sense amplifier for nonvolatile memories that compares a bitline current against a reference current to determine the memory cell state. It uses a current mirror to supply a reference current and diode-connected transistors to clamp the bitline voltage, enabling low-voltage operation.

paper_reference.title: A High-Performance Very Low-Voltage Current Sense Amplifier for Nonvolatile Memories

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the sense amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VREF=0.6V, I_XM3 = 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (0.6-0.42)^2 = ~43uA. Total current from VDD includes XM4/XM5 branches. Total current ~150uA. Power = 1.8V * 150uA = 270uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher than the paper due to the 1.8V supply and 0.6V reference voltage used in the testbench to ensure robust operation in SKY130.

delay_rise.description: Read access time when the memory cell is OFF (bitline voltage rises).

sky130_expected.calculation: Charging a 1pF bitline capacitance with ~43uA reference current: dV/dt = 43uA / 1pF = 43mV/ns. Time to reach 0.3V is approx 7ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the assumed bitline capacitance (1pF used in testbench) and the reference current set by VREF.

delay_fall.description: Read access time when the memory cell is ON (bitline voltage falls).

sky130_expected.calculation: Discharging 1pF bitline capacitance with (80uA cell current - 43uA ref current) = 37uA net current. dV/dt = 37uA / 1pF = 37mV/ns. Time to drop 0.3V is approx 8ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Slightly slower than rise time due to the net discharge current being smaller than the charging current.

v_swing.description: Voltage swing on the bitline between ON and OFF states.

sky130_expected.calculation: Clamped by diode-connected XM1. For 43uA, Vgs = Vth + sqrt(2*Id/(un*Cox*W/L)) = 0.42 + sqrt(2*43u/(270u*10)) = 0.42 + 0.18 = 0.6V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the threshold voltage and overdrive of the clamping NMOS transistor in SKY130.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, bitline voltage swing, and read access time (delay) for both rising and falling transitions using a 1pF bitline capacitance and an 80uA cell current.
step3_testbench.spice:
* High-Performance Very Low-Voltage Current Sense Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM3 N0 VREF GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM1 BL BL GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM7 VREF VREF N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM9 N3 BL GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM5 BL N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM8 N3 VREF GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Bitline capacitance
Cbl BL 0 1p

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVREF VREF 0 0.6

* Cell current simulation using a voltage-controlled current source
* IN_T=1 represents cell ON (sinking 80uA), IN_T=0 represents cell OFF (0uA)
V_in_timing IN_T 0 PULSE(1 0 10n 0.1n 0.1n 40n 80n)
G_Icell BL 0 IN_T 0 80u

.control
  * DC Operating Point for Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * Transient Analysis for Delay and Swing
  tran 0.1n 80n
  
  meas tran v_bl_max max v(BL)
  meas tran v_bl_min min v(BL)
  let v_swing = v_bl_max - v_bl_min
  print v_swing

  * Measure read access time (delay)
  * Cell turns OFF at 10ns -> BL rises
  meas tran delay_rise trig v(IN_T) val=0.5 fall=1 targ v(BL) val=0.3 rise=1
  
  * Cell turns ON at 50.1ns -> BL falls
  meas tran delay_fall trig v(IN_T) val=0.5 rise=1 targ v(BL) val=0.3 fall=1
.endc
.end
